text: List properties in cards on both clients, one order: Clear checked first, then List, Categories, Notes, Shared with, Notifications, Closing, Actions, Leave

Correction (maintainer): 'Clear checked items' stays where it is today, directly under the type selector, as the last element of the List card; it is NOT a card of its own at the top. Order: 1. List (name + Save, type selector with help, Clear checked items (N) on non-ledgers), 2. Categories, 3. Notes, 4. Shared with, 5. Notifications (Android), 6. Closing (ledgers), 7. Actions (Duplicate list), 8. Leave/Delete list (danger card).

Also (found in T-336): Material cards take their default content colour from the scheme slot equal to their container; tertiaryContainer == surfaceContainerHighest, so card text defaults to onTertiaryContainer = the accent text colour. That is why the overview's list names are blue. Fix in the theme: onTertiaryContainer = Foreground in both schemes (or give Card a plain contentColor everywhere); overview ListCard, invitation cards and VoteCard then read in the plain text colour, as on the web. SectionCard's explicit contentColor can stay or go.

On main (45f1f719..f366963b), full gate green: list properties in cards on both clients in the agreed order (Clear checked last in the List card); Android onTertiaryContainer = foreground so every card writes in plain text. Wording drift left for a follow-up: Android 'List name'/'Shared with' vs web 'Name'/'Members'.
